Class RoundFlow

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.RoundFlow
public class RoundFlow extends Object
Keeps the round-level flow of a game.

This class knows which phase of the round is active, which players are allowed to act in that phase, which player is currently expected to act, and which round number is being played.

The player order is the order of the current phase, not a single fixed order for the whole round. During one round the game can use different orders:

  • during RoundPhase.PLACING_TOTEMS, players act in the starting tile order;
  • during RoundPhase.PLAYER_DRAWS, players act in the offer-path resolution order;
  • during RoundPhase.EXTRA_DRAWS, only the player eligible for the extra draw acts.

It does not know the rules of totem placement, card drafting, extra draws, effects, disconnections, or scoring. Those rules belong to higher-level game flow classes. This class only stores the current phase, the current order, and the cursor inside that order.

    • setCurrentPhaseOrder

      public void setCurrentPhaseOrder(List<Player> newOrder)
      Replaces the current phase order and moves the cursor to the first player.

      This method is intentionally used more than once during a round. For example, after all totems have been placed, the game replaces the totem placement order with the card draw order.

      The order must contain at least one player because the rest of the round-flow API always assumes that a current player exists.

      Parameters:
      newOrder - new ordered list of players
